Overcome the twelve habits holding you back and take your career to new heights with this wise and approachable guide from two business leadership experts.
Ready to take the next step in your career . . . but not sure what’s holding you back? Read on.
Leadership expert Sally Helgesen and bestselling leadership coach Marshall Goldsmith have trained thousands of high achievers — men and women — to reach even greater heights. Again and again, they see that women face specific and different roadblocks from men as they advance in the workplace.

The most frequent response women have to How Women Rise since its first day of publication has been: “That describes me! This is exactly what I do!”

As we seek to rise to the next level, we may find that the habits that made us successful no longer serve us. Yet we remain loyal to these habits because they have served us in the past. In How Women Rise, Sally partners with coaching legend Marshall Goldsmith to identify the behaviors most likely to undermine talented women.

These behaviors include:

...

Expertise
* Building Rather than Leveraging Relationships
* Failing to Enlist Allies from Day One
* Putting Your Job Before Your Career
* The Disease to Please
* The Desire to be Perfect
* Minimizing
* Too Much
* Ruminating
* Letting Your Radar Distract You
Sally and Marshall not only identify the behaviors most likely to hold women back, they offer practical solutions. Both the habits and their solutions cut across culture. Which is why rights have sold in 24 languages. And they often apply to women at every level.

Sally Helgesen is widely regarded as a gold standard author and speaker for women in leadership. Friends over twenty-five years, Sally and Marshall have now teamed up to publish How Women Rise , combining Sally’s experience and insights with women in leadership together with Marshall’s framework for identifying and overcoming personal, self-limiting behaviors.
